system: Living cells and populations: phase abundances in dividing cell populations and resource competition; other topic lanes are classified below.

mapping.F: free energy stored by a cell (nutrient and ATP reserves) relative to its medium; not needed for phase abundances, where phase durations are measured directly
mapping.P: metabolic burn power of the cell; in the resource lane, consumption fixed by monoculture physiology (as in T007)
mapping.b: rate of entry into a phase; grows as e^{lambda t} in an exponentially growing culture (layer23.abundance_growing), constant in a steady tissue

observable.quantity: fraction of cells in a cell-cycle phase (snapshot) against the fraction implied by independently timed phase durations
